title: An endpoint lower bound for Schatten–Hlawka constants
description: Unrefereed, AI-assisted mathematical candidate on endpoint asymptotics for Schatten–Hlawka constants. An inherited two-dimensional projector family gives a quantitative lower bound; optimization and logarithmic parameter correction are established only within that family. No matching unrestricted upper bound, external peer review or proof-assistant verification is claimed. Original prose and data are CC0-1.0; original executable code is MIT. Publisher and repository operator: Evidence Press.
